entities.name: Query flavohemoprotein
observations: Sequence analysis reports 403 residues, approximately 45.1 kDa, and no transmembrane annotation.
Pfam evidence identifies an N-terminal globin/protoglobin region at residues 2–134 and C-terminal FAD-binding and NAD-binding domains.
Closest reviewed homologs are Bacillus flavohemoproteins with 61.6–62.1% identity and 100% query coverage.
Function is inferred with moderate homology support rather than directly experimentally established for this exact sequence.

entities.name: Bacterial flavohemoprotein
observations: Reviewed Bacillus homologs bind one heme b and one FAD per subunit.
Reviewed homologs are annotated as nitric oxide dioxygenases involved in aerobic NO detoxification.
Reviewed homologs are cytoplasmic where localization is available.
EC 1.14.12.17 is associated with the nitric oxide dioxygenase activity.

entities.name: Nitric oxide dioxygenation
observations: Overall NADPH-linked reaction: 2 nitric oxide + NADPH + 2 O2 → 2 nitrate + NADP+ + H+; Rhea RHEA:19465.
Alternative NADH-linked reaction: 2 nitric oxide + NADH + 2 O2 → 2 nitrate + NAD+ + H+; Rhea RHEA:19469.
The enzyme uses reduced pyridine nucleotide electrons through FAD to support heme-dependent NO dioxygenation.

entities.name: Heme b
observations: Reviewed homologs bind one heme b prosthetic group per subunit; the globin domain supplies the oxygen/NO-binding catalytic module.

entities.name: FAD
observations: Reviewed homologs bind one FAD per subunit; the FAD reductase domain transfers electrons from NAD(P)H.

entities.name: Aryl vinyl Stille coupling
observations: Vinyltributyltin couples with the aryl chloride under Pd catalysis to replace C–Cl by a vinyl group.
The aryl electrophile is 1-chloro-2,6-dinitrobenzene based on ring substitution pattern.

entities.name: 2,6-Dinitrostyrene
observations: Predicted product connectivity: 1-vinyl-2,6-dinitrobenzene, formed by replacing aryl chloride with CH=CH2.
